acceptanceCriteria: A new daily-loop harness revision pins the preregistration digest in a committed file (as benchmarks/untouched-repository-v1/preregistration.sha256 does) instead of trusting --prereg-sha256 alone.

Each loop step runs with a scrubbed environment: every DOGFOOD_* variable and host Git configuration (GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM, HOME) is set by the harness, so an omitted-input variant cannot inherit the value from the operator's shell.
The L3c re-encoded control changes the committed CEM bytes (noncanonical re-encode) and fails the row if the commit status is nonzero, so the control cannot pass as a no-op.
The bind git add and commit run with check=True, and a failed bind makes the loop row FAIL with the git exit status instead of continuing.
The frozen daily-loop-v0 harness and its preregistered digest are not edited; the fix lands as a new preregistered revision with its own seal and a build-log entry naming the old defects.
body: benchmarks/daily-loop-v0/harness.py at d22b9ef0 has four defects found while building the V1-0019 chi case-freeze harness, which fixed the same shapes. (1) harness.py:586 compares preregistration.json against the operator-supplied --prereg-sha256, and the corpus and harness digests are then read from that same file, so no committed value pins the preregistration. (2) harness.py:385 starts from dict(os.environ): a DOGFOOD_* input that a variant omits (L5, L6) can still arrive from the operator's shell, and host Git configuration reaches every step. (3) harness.py:411-412 run the bind git add and commit with check=False, so a failed bind continues to the next dogfood-change and check. (4) harness.py:458-464 re-encodes the CEM with canonical() and commits with capture_output and no status check; a CEM already in canonical form yields identical bytes, the commit fails with nothing to commit, and L3c then checks the unmodified tree. The harness digest is preregistered, so the fix is a new harness revision, not an in-place edit (decision 0423 non-goals). Filed under the owner rule that known bugs are fixed before the next release.
title: Fix the daily-loop-v0 harness: pinned prereg digest, scrubbed env, checked bind commit, real L3c control
